messages:
Maria: Quick sync — onboarding atlas-xt-7b. Who owns the canonical weights path and can share checksum + manifest? Need to start registry mirroring and give infra the IAM role before Friday.
Kevin: I uploaded the HF source and a mirror stub. HF repo: https://huggingface.co/redwood/atlas-xt-7b. S3 mirror prefix: s3://redwood-artifacts/models/atlas-xt-7b/2025-02-12/. Manifest pushed to that prefix as manifest.json. SHA256: `f4e2b7a9d9b0b7c6f3a2e4c1c9e7a8b6d2c3f1e4a6b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f`. ACL: bucket-owner-full-control.
Sasha: Tokenizer heads-up: this model uses a custom BPE where pad token id != 0 (pad_offset: 1). This broke a few evals until I set `pad_to_multiple_of` and mapped offsets. Add tokenizer metadata to manifest.
Dev: For mirroring, infra prefers presigned URLs with TTL >= 24h for bulk sync. Kevin, can you regenerate presigns for the shard objects with 24h TTL? Also manifest schema should include `checksum_alg` and `size_bytes` per shard.
Kevin: Yep, will regen presigns. Manifest currently has shards array w/ fields: `path`, `sha256`, `size_bytes`, `origin` (hf|s3). I'll add `tokenizer_meta` with `pad_offset` and `vocab_size`.
Ron: CI note — the ingest pipeline expects `checksum_alg` exactly set to `sha256` and a top-level `manifest_sha256` for the whole manifest file. Also we need to grant role `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/ingest-mirror` s3:GetObject on the prefix.
Maria: Thanks. I'll open an infra ticket to attach the role to the mirror job and update the onboarding checklist. Quick ask: who can review the manifest PR? @Kevin?
Kevin: I can review later today. Two quick nits: include `tokenizer.version` and `sample_tokenization_tests` (small list of inputs+expected token ids) so QA can run tokenization-sanity automatically.
Sasha: Example test snippet to include in manifest (put under `tokenizer_tests`):
```
{"input": "Hello world", "expected_ids": [1543, 523, 2]}
```
Run `tools/tokenizer_sanity.py --manifest s3://.../manifest.json` after mirror.
artifact-bot: mirror-job queued for s3://redwood-artifacts/models/atlas-xt-7b/2025-02-12/ — status: pending. (automated)
Dev: After Kevin posts new presigns I'll kick the mirror dry-run. If any shard fails the checksum step we'll fallback to HF-origin pull.
Maria: OK I'll push the PR with IAM update and ping the ingest ticket. Will also add the `manifest_sha256`. Thanks :thumbsup:
Kevin: PR posted: https://github.com/redwood-inference/artifact-registry/pull/482 — PTAL.
Sasha: Running tokenization-sanity locally now, will report back in this thread if offsets look off.
Ron: Once mirroring completes, I'll run the CI ingest smoke and mark onboarding ready.
Maria: Perfect — tagging this as "ready-for-mirror" in the checklist. Thanks everyone — ping me if anything blocks by EOD. :rocket:
